summary: Invalidate pending installed claims contradicted by daily iOS device readback, including successful installs whose launch failed.

downtime.detail: No live device or scheduler change.

manual.detail: Uses the same operator repin and --reconcile-installed rollout described by the installed-build readback change.

recovery.detail: A successful readback clears a pending installed claim when its build differs from the observed build. Retrying or superseding a failed launch cannot restore stale installed identity or lower the version floor; finalization also preserves the maximum floor.
